title: Store leaks the database driver to its callers
body:
### Where

`internal/store/store.go:40`, `internal/store/index.go:12`

review-key: code/leaky-abstraction/internal/store

### Problem

`Store.Query` and `Store.Tx` expose `*sql.DB` and `*sql.Tx`, so handlers build SQL against the driver and any storage change reaches every caller.

### Fix

See the problem.

### Done when

- [ ] Fixed

title: Logging: error wraps drop the cause chain
body:
### Where

`internal/http/repo/orders.go:25`, `internal/http/stripe/client.go:41`

review-key: o11y/error-wrap-drops-cause/internal/http

### Problem

Every wrap site uses `fmt.Errorf` with `%s` and `err.Error()`, so `Unwrap` returns nil and `errors.Is` stops working.
